title: EvaluatorInput
description: The image is under review; the claim is the specification it is checked against. One image per call.

image_path.description: Local path (absolute, or relative to the working directory) to the image under review. Read in the caller's environment; format identified by file signature, not extension. The `x-image` bounds are enforced before any model call; an image outside them is rejected, not resized.

claim.description: The specification the image is checked against: a statement about what it shows ("The chart shows 12 apples."), or a question with its expected answer as `Question: "<question>" The answer is <answer>.`
